Name: xgboost_hyperparameter_tuning
Title: Optimizing Tree-Based Nonlinearity: XGBoost Hyperparameter Search on Evo2 Embeddings
Experiment: Load cached embeddings from run_0/data/embeddings_evo2_7b.npy and labels from run_0/data/dataset.json. Perform a grid search over XGBoost hyperparameters: n_estimators=[100,200,500], max_depth=[3,4,6], learning_rate=[0.01,0.05,0.1], subsample=[0.7,0.8,1.0]. Use 5-fold stratified CV with scale_pos_weight to handle class imbalance. Report best AUROC, best params, and a heatmap of AUROC vs max_depth × learning_rate. Compare best XGBoost to LR, SVM, and MLP baselines. Also extract XGBoost feature importances (gain-based) and plot top-30 embedding dimensions.
